latest_cos_commentary.headline: Marigold's enterprise loyalty/marketing software business (Marigold Loyalty, Cheetah Digital, Sailthru, Selligent, Liveclicker, Grow) was acquired by Zeta Global in a deal that closed November 24, 2025; Marigold's SMB brands (Campaign Monitor, Emma, Vuture) were not included and remain independent.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Marigold Loyalty is a direct competitor to Genius's loyalty_engagement product line, with confirmed restaurant-brand usage (KFC Rewards, White Castle Crave Continuum, Bloomin' Brands/Outback punch-card campaigns); now operates under Zeta Global's ownership and balance sheet.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Recently closed acquisition (Nov 2025) means the product is now backed by Zeta Global's resources and cross-sell base (Zeta's broader ad-tech/CDP customers), which could accelerate enterprise loyalty deal flow going forward.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: If a prospect currently runs Marigold Loyalty, note the recent Zeta Global ownership change — ask whether their contract, support, or roadmap has changed since the November 2025 transition, since new ownership can create a natural point to re-evaluate vendors.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Treat this as a name/ownership change, not a product shutdown — Marigold Loyalty continues operating under Zeta Global; do not assume disruption to existing customer contracts without direct confirmation.
